Contract Administration & General Information • Funding: The Government will review responses and seek funding for the most innovative and affordable solutions. All awards are subject to the availability of funds. • Pricing Strategy: Any resulting award will be a firm-fixed-price contract subject to RFO FAR 12.205 Solicitation provisions and contract clauses. • Security Requirements: Offerors will require access to classified information up to the SECRET level. The TWS serves as the central incident management system, providing real-time command, control and graphical monitoring for the squadron's life-safety infrastructure. c.
